Noon is a letter. Allah swears by the pen and by what people write.
By your Lord's kindness, you are not crazy.
You will have a reward that never ends.
And you have a great and good character.
Soon you will see, and they will see.
Who is the one that is troubled?
Your Lord knows best who went away from His way. And He knows best who is on the right way.
So do not obey the people who say it is a lie.
They wish you would give in a little, so they would give in too.
And do not obey a person who swears a lot and has a low character.
He talks about people behind their backs and spreads lies.
He stops good things, goes too far and does wrong.
He is rude, and he is a fake too.
Just because he has money and children.
When Our verses are read to him, he says: Old stories!
We will mark his nose.
We tested them like We tested the owners of the garden. They promised to pick the fruit in the morning.
And they did not say: If Allah wills.
But a trouble from your Lord went all around the garden while they slept.
And in the morning it was like it was all picked.
In the morning they called to each other.
Go early to your garden if you want to pick the fruit.
So they went, whispering to each other.
No poor person may come in on you today.
They went early, sure they could keep the poor out.
But when they saw the garden, they said: We must have lost our way!
No, we have lost everything.
The best one of them said: Did I not tell you to praise Allah?
They said: Glory to our Lord! We did wrong.
Then they turned to each other and blamed each other.
They said: How terrible for us! We went too far.
Maybe our Lord will give us a better garden. We turn to our Lord.
That is the punishment. But the punishment in the next life is bigger, if only they knew.
For people who fear Allah, there are gardens of joy with their Lord.
Should We treat people who obey Allah like people who do bad things?
What is wrong with you? How do you decide?
Or do you have a book that you read.
In which you find whatever you choose?
Or do you have promises from Us that last until the Day of Judgment, that you will get what you want?
Ask them: Which one of them will promise that?
Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they are telling the truth.
On the Day when things become very hard, they will be called to bow down, but they will not be able to.
Their eyes will be low and shame will cover them. They were called to bow down when they were well, but they did not.
So leave Me with the people who say this message is a lie. We will take them step by step from where they do not know.
And I will give them time. My plan is strong.
Or do you ask them for pay, so that they are weighed down with debt?
Or do they know what is hidden, so they write it down?
So be patient with what your Lord decides. Do not be like the man of the fish, Yunus, who called out in sadness.
If his Lord's kindness had not reached him, he would have been thrown on empty land in shame.
But his Lord chose him and made him one of the good people.
People who said no almost knock you down with their looks when they hear the message. They say: He is crazy!
But this is only a reminder for all people.
